## Do not do

The following are hard boundaries for this issue, even if a change seems useful:

<!-- List specific prohibited changes, including tempting related work. Do not
write only "out of scope". -->

-

If the work appears to require crossing a boundary, stop the affected part and
record the concrete reason. Continue independent work within scope and return
the boundary change to the design owner. Do not expand the issue or its
authority unilaterally.
